description: The Vibe and Codas Team is made from three friends on their first try on a hackathon, we are three programmers who appreciate a good laugh and a challenge
summary:
A.H.M.S ( Astronaut Health Monitoring System ), aims to be a personal health monitor for each astronaut, displaying countermeasures, estimated bone loss for many bones

Coded in rust, it aims to be lightweight and fast, making it responsive in such a harsh environment

Such a system could be essential in micro-gravity environments, being responsible for reminding each astronaut individually
details:
It uses NASA data for bone loss, in the example, it uses the median human BMD, linked in the research papers, we use that data and the days in micro-gravity, calculate the estimate percentage lost.

This is made in rust, my first ever project in that language, even if its unfinished, i had a lot of fun making it

it was supossed to have a GUI, only one screen since you cant really touch anything without physical buttons in a space suit.
